limitations: All direct CMP_CLK loads, original comparator-output MOMs and complete X002/X003 receiving buffers are retained. PR/NR downstream qualification fanout and WD-to-X010 fanout remain omitted loading differences.
Q1/LIVE/CLOCK_RESET/CLOCK_Q/CMP_CLK/COMP_P/COMP_N/PR/NR/WD are native generated outputs. No ideal voltage source may drive any of these nodes.
Only seven upstream/input nodes are voltage-replayed. This peak-attribution fixture does not validate complete asynchronous decisions or sizing; local waveform equivalence must be checked first.

receiver_output_load_addition.purpose: Avoid double-driving comparator outputs while keeping their real immediate receiving loads
receiver_output_load_addition.omitted_fanout: PR/NR normally drive DATA/XOR/qualification logic. Their buffer outputs remain naturally driven here, with omitted downstream loads disclosed rather than forced to baseline voltages.

retained_forward_logic.note: CN is generated by the already counted X015. Replay SAMPLE_INT/PHI_W/PHI_U/ACTIVE at their input boundaries, retaining actual last-stage Q1/LIVE/CLOCK_RESET drivers.
omitted_feedback: PHI_W is replayed instead of generated by local receiver/qualification/write buffering.
PHI_U is replayed instead of generated by local write delay and its downstream bit/reference loads.
ACTIVE is replayed instead of OR-decoding a shifting native token register.
No complete SAR bit registers, reference word/capture or CDAC/Bootstrap are restored.
XCLOCK internal feedback, X025/CMP_CLK and CN-to-Q1 local feedback remain native.

totals.extra_controlled_sources: Seven upstream/input voltage replays only: SAMPLE_INT, PHI_W, PHI_U, ACTIVE, DEC, TOPP and TOPN. WD/COMP_P/COMP_N are witnesses only. No gate-current replay source.
totals.definition: Device instances, not transistor multiplicity or physical unit count; all original sizes/multiplicities retained.
